question: Where is the National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) located?
solution:
The correct answer is Hyderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​​​One of the** centres of the Indian Space Research Organization** is the National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), which is situated in **Hyderabad, Telangana is one of the centres of the Indian Space Research Organisation.** Data from aerial and satellite sources are managed by** NRSC.**
 
• **The National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) in Hyderabad **is in charge of data collection and processing from remote sensing satellites, data dissemination, aerial remote sensing, and disaster management decision support.
 
• In India, **there are five RRSSCs, **or Regional Remote Sensing Service Centers.** Bangalore, Jodhpur, Kolkata, Delhi (formerly in Dehradun), and Nagpur **are where you can find them. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO)** Department of Space's National Remote Sensing Center** (NRSC) is one of its main centres (DOS). **
 
• The **National Remote Sensing Association (NRSA) was founded in 1974** as a registered society under the Department of Science & Technology with the purpose of carrying out and **supporting remote sensing activities** throughout the nation.
 
• **Director of the National Remote Sensing Center** is Dr. Prakash Chauhan. **Dr. Prakash Chauhan,** who was born on May 15, 1969, earned a Ph.D. and a postgraduate degree in Applied Geophysics from the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Roorkee.**
 
• In 1916, the **Republican Senatorial Campaign Committee**—the NRSC—was established. In 1948, it underwent a name change to become the **National Republican Senatorial Committee**. The NRSC primarily uses fundraising to assist Republican incumbents and challengers in **winning elections. **
